definitions.gloss: business partner, client company, trading partner
definitions.explanation: A company or individual with whom one conducts business transactions. Can refer to clients, suppliers, or any party in a business relationship.

examples.japanese: {取引先|とりひきさき}に{連絡|れんらく}する。
{取引先|とりひきさき}との{会議|かいぎ}が{午後|ごご}にある。
examples.english: There's a meeting with a client company this afternoon.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{取引先|とりひきさき}を{開拓|かいたく}するために{営業|えいぎょう}{活動|かつどう}を{強化|きょうか}している。
examples.english: We're strengthening our sales activities to develop new business partners.

notes:
STRUCTURE:
Compound of {取引|とりひき} (business transaction) + {先|さき} (destination/party). The {先|さき} suffix is common in business vocabulary to indicate the other party: {連絡先|れんらくさき} (contact), {届|とど}け{先|さき} (delivery destination), {仕入|しい}れ{先|さき} (supplier).

USAGE:
A core business vocabulary word. Used in workplace conversations, emails, and reports. {取引先|とりひきさき} is broader than "client" — it encompasses any company you do business with, whether they buy from you or you buy from them.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {取引先|とりひきさき}を{訪問|ほうもん}する: to visit a business partner
- {取引先|とりひきさき}との{関係|かんけい}: relationship with a business partner
- {主要|しゅよう}{取引先|とりひきさき}: major business partner
- {取引先|とりひきさき}を{開拓|かいたく}する: to develop new business partners
